Patient Safety

Hospital-Grade Infection Control Protocol

We maintain rigorous anti-cross-contamination protocols exceeding national standards.

01

Hospital-grade 4-step sterilization: ultrasonic cleaning, enzymatic disinfection, pouching, and autoclave

02

Surface barrier films replaced between every patient visit

03

Hospital-grade air filtration in operatories

04

Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) protocol adhered to strictly

Class-B Fractional Vacuum Autoclave

Unlike simple desktop steamers, Class-B fractionated pre-vacuum autoclaves extract 99% of air from hollow dental handpieces and surgical burs, ensuring 134°C saturated steam reaches every inner lumen.

Zero Compromise Safety
